- The delta is 22,240 tokens. At the contracted rate (0.0003 per token), this is $6.672 — however, Horizon is taxed in their jurisdiction and the VAT handling means the reissued amounts must show VAT separately.
- Root cause: a short-lived duplicate batch job from Aug 14–15 briefly re-submitted replay traffic to their org id; it was auto-ingested and billed. We have a server-side dedupe patch to prevent recurrence.

Recommendation:
1) Issue a goodwill credit note for the billed delta (gross + VAT line), and reissue invoice HZN-202608 reflecting the corrected usage.
2) Provide a short explanation and the internal patch ETA (done 2026-08-20) so Horizon can close their internal audit.
3) Release the payment hold after Horizon confirms the corrected invoice satisfies AP.
